title: repos.json
description: The repos that make up an agentic-os workspace, each cloned to <workspace>/<relativePath>. Read by the dashboard's Repos page, discover.mjs, doctor.mjs and the team's own skills.

relativePath.description: Where the repo lives, relative to the workspace root, e.g. "api" or "services/billing". Defaults to name. No absolute paths, no "..".

remote.description: What `git clone` is given, e.g. https://github.com/acme/api.git.

layer.description: Free text for grouping (backend, frontend, infrastructure, ...).

defaultBranch.description: Checked out after cloning; the remote's default when omitted.

dependencies.description: Names of repos this one consumes (for implementation and PR order).

directory.description: Old name for relativePath; still read.

url.description: Old name for remote; still read.
